name: Cure Wounds
description:
A creature you touch may regain 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier or recover 1 Stress Slot. If the creature has more than 0 hit points, it may roll its Hit Die, and the number rolled is added to the healing. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

**At Higher Levels.** When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the healing and stress recovery increase by 1d8 and 1 slot, respectively, for each slot level above 1st.
